Name: Arza, Steward of Elah
Summary: Arza was steward of Elah's house in Tirzah, in whose house the drunken king was slain by Zimri.
KeyStory: Arza's house, where Elah was slain.
RelatedPeople: Elah, King of Israel; Zimri, King of Israel
LifeLesson: A steward's house became a crime scene when his master drank on duty.
